SEARCH
Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingThroughputBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingThroughputBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingThroughputBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable flow-rate receipt derived from a qualified hydrotreating recycle balance.

The receipt converts an upstream mass basis to kg/h and kmol/h without changing its chemistry, recovery, or purge assumptions. Internal recycle is reported but excluded from the external mass balance.

Version:
1.0
Author:
esolbr1
